dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 02, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**PHILLIES SHUT DOWN ORIOLES 8-0**

The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, behind a strong team effort from their pitching staff. Zack Wheeler was impressive in relief, tossing 2 scoreless innings with 3 strikeouts. Bryan De La Cruz led the offense, hitting a home run and driving in 3 runs. Justin Crawford also contributed, scoring on a sacrifice fly by Kyle Schwarber.

**BRUINS TAKE DOWN NATIONALS 4-2**

The Atlanta Braves edged out the Washington Nationals, thanks in part to a strong performance from Didier Fuentes, who tossed 2 scoreless innings with 4 strikeouts. Mike Yastrzemski hit a home run and drove in 2 runs for the Nationals, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Braves' offense. Dylan Dodd earned the win for Atlanta.

**CARDS TAKE DOWN BLUE JAYS 5-1**

The St. Louis Cardinals defeated the Toronto Blue Jays behind a strong outing from Matthew Liberatore, who tossed 6 scoreless innings with 7 strikeouts. Jordan Walker led the offense, driving in 2 runs on 2 hits. George Soriano earned the win for the Cardinals.

**GUARDIANS SHUT DOWN DIAMONDBACKS 5-0**

The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Arizona Diamondbacks, behind a strong performance from Gavin Williams, who tossed 5.2 scoreless innings with 10 strikeouts. Patrick Bailey hit a home run for the Diamondbacks, but it was not enough to overcome the Guardians' pitching. Gavin Williams earned the win for Cleveland.

**REDS ROUT PIRATES 10-2**

The Cincinnati Reds defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates behind a strong outing from Chase Burns, who tossed 6 scoreless innings with 9 strikeouts. Tyler Stephenson hit a home run and drove in 2 runs for the Reds, while Jacob Gonzalez and Sal Stewart also contributed to the offense.

**WHITE SOX TAKE DOWN RAYS 9-1**

The Chicago White Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, behind a strong performance from Griffin Jax, who tossed 5 scoreless innings with 8 strikeouts. Everson Pereira hit a home run and drove in 4 runs for the White Sox, while Miguel Vargas and Andrew Benintendi also contributed to the offense.

**MARLINS SHUT DOWN METS 2-0**

The Miami Marlins defeated the New York Mets behind a strong outing from Sandy Alcantara, who tossed 6 scoreless innings with 5 strikeouts. Joe Mack hit a home run for the Marlins, while Xavier Edwards also contributed to the offense.

**ASTROS TAKE DOWN RANGERS 7-3**

The Houston Astros defeated the Texas Rangers behind a strong performance from Peter Lambert, who tossed 5.2 scoreless innings with 8 strikeouts. Jeremy Peña hit a home run and drove in 2 runs for the Astros, while Yordan Alvarez also contributed to the offense.

**YANKEES TAKE DOWN CUBS 2-1**

The New York Yankees edged out the Chicago Cubs, thanks in part to a strong performance from Colin Rea, who tossed 6 scoreless innings with 7 strikeouts. José Caballero hit a home run for the Yankees, while Seiya Suzuki also contributed to the offense.

**ROCKIES SHUT DOWN ROYALS 8-1**

The Colorado Rockies dominated the Kansas City Royals, behind a strong performance from Kyle Freeland, who tossed 9 scoreless innings with 8 strikeouts. Jake McCarthy hit a home run for the Royals, but it was not enough to overcome the Rockies' pitching.

**ANGELS TAKE DOWN BREWERS 3-0**

The Los Angeles Angels defeated the Milwaukee Brewers behind a strong outing from Jacob Misiorowski, who tossed 7 scoreless innings with 10 strikeouts. Wade Meckler hit a home run for the Angels, while Zach Neto also contributed to the offense.

**TIGERS SHUT DOWN ATHLETICS 11-0**

The Detroit Tigers dominated the Athletics, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Eduardo Valencia hit a home run and drove in 4 runs for the Tigers, while Dillon Dingler and Spencer Torkelson also contributed to the offense.

**PADRES TAKE DOWN GIANTS 5-4**

The San Diego Padres edged out the San Francisco Giants, thanks in part to a strong performance from Adrian Morejon, who tossed 1.1 scoreless innings with 3 strikeouts. Jackson Merrill hit a home run for the Padres, while Rafael Devers also contributed to the offense.

**MARINERS TAKE DOWN TWINS 7-6**

The Seattle Mariners defeated the Minnesota Twins behind a strong performance from George Kirby, who tossed 7 scoreless innings with 3 strikeouts. Royce Lewis hit a home run for the Twins, but it was not enough to overcome the Mariners' offense.

**RED SOX TAKE DOWN DODGERS 8-4**

The Boston Red Sox dominated the Los Angeles Dodgers, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Masataka Yoshida hit a home run and drove in 2 runs for the Red Sox, while Ceddanne Rafaela and Wilyer Abreu also contributed to the offense.
